name: Shifting Style
descriptionText: Shifting style often changes Attached characters to maximize their impact.

abilities.name: Shifting Style
abilities.rulesText: Whenever you first Attach yourself to a specific character during this Round, use Leech on them for free.

actions.name: Dynamic Attachment
actions.rulesText:
Can be used once per Turn, during other character's turn.
Attach yourself to a character within range. You cannot be attached to more than 1 character and you break Attachment when you select a new target.

actions.name: Giveaway
actions.rulesText:
Transfer up to 2 of your Tokens to the Attached Character.
6+: up to 4 Tokens instead.
9+ up to 6 Tokens instead.
